tasks.title: Freeze Fate MCP architecture, scope, and release gates
tasks.description: Establish the module's strict source-to-concentration boundary, supported v0.1 scenario classes, semantic conventions, and repository skeleton before implementation begins.
tasks.details: Translate the PRD into explicit ADRs and an implementation charter. Publish decisions covering module purpose, non-goals (no direct human dose, no dietary intake, no PBPK execution, no final risk characterization), deterministic-or-bounded-first strategy for v0.1, plugin architecture by fate model family, and the requirement that every concentration result exposes assumptions and provenance explicitly. Scaffold the repository with src/fate_mcp/, plugins/, defaults/, docs/contracts/schemas/, schemas/examples/, tests/, docs/, and config/. Define release gates for benchmark replication, schema integrity, downstream concentration-bundle consumability, and failure-mode transparency.
tasks.testStrategy: Review ADRs and release-gate criteria with stack owners and confirm the repository skeleton, docs, and CI baseline reflect the agreed source-to-concentration boundary.

subtasks.title: Codify source-to-concentration ownership and exclusions
subtasks.description: Document exactly what Fate MCP does and does not own.
subtasks.details: Create docs/adr/0001-fate-boundary.md defining in-scope responsibilities: environmental release scenarios, multimedia transfer, compartment concentration estimation, concentration surfaces, comparison outputs, and downstream concentration bundles. Explicitly exclude direct human dose, dietary intake, PBPK execution, risk characterization, and arbitrary model-native desktop file ingestion as the public contract.
subtasks.testStrategy: Cross-check the ADR against the PRD and confirm the README, roadmap, and backlog all reflect the same ownership boundary.

subtasks.title: Adopt deterministic-and-bounded-first v0.1 strategy
subtasks.description: Freeze the execution philosophy for the first release.
subtasks.details: Record the decision that v0.1 prioritizes deterministic steady-state or bounded time-bucket fate runs over full Monte Carlo or dynamic GIS dispersion. Capture the rationale: transparent validation, tractable benchmarks, and a cleaner adapter boundary for later probabilistic orchestration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate that the roadmap and planned tool catalog do not accidentally depend on deferred probabilistic or high-resolution dispersion functionality.

subtasks.title: Define scenario classes, compartment taxonomy, and time semantics
subtasks.description: Freeze the fate taxonomy used across schemas and runtime.
subtasks.details: Publish a scenario-class matrix for release scenarios, run options, steady-state outputs, and bounded time-bucket outputs. Define mandatory compartment tags, geographic/context semantics, and time-window rules so every result is explicit about medium, scope, and temporal interpretation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the taxonomy in draft schemas and examples and ensure every planned tool maps to exactly one scenario class or conversion path.

subtasks.title: Define media, unit, and provenance-governance policy
subtasks.description: Create cross-cutting rules for environmental media, concentration units, defaults, and assumptions.
subtasks.details: Specify allowed release media, canonical concentration units, compatible compartment combinations, evidence-quality categories, and failure rules for impossible inputs. Require that every default cite a versioned source and that every applied assumption is emitted in a fate assumption record.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review the policy against downstream concentration consumers and confirm no planned plugin uses ambiguous media tags, units, or hidden defaults.

subtasks.title: Scaffold repository, CI, and baseline developer workflow
subtasks.description: Create the implementation skeleton and minimum automation required for the module.
subtasks.details: Initialize src/fate_mcp/__init__.py, __main__.py, contracts.py, models.py, defaults.py, provenance.py, runtime.py, result_meta.py, integrations.py, package_metadata.py, release_artifacts.py, guidance.py, examples.py, benchmarks.py, validation.py, and plugins/. Add defaults/v1/, docs/contracts/schemas/, schemas/examples/, docs/releases/, and tests/. Wire lint/test/build commands and a placeholder contract-generation step into CI.
subtasks.testStrategy: Clone and run the empty scaffold in a clean environment, verifying lint/test commands, contract generation, and placeholder plugin registration work.

tasks.title: Publish the Fate MCP contract and schema layer
tasks.description: Define the complete versioned object model, media/time conventions, examples, and manifests before implementing calculators.
tasks.details: Create the public schema pack under docs/contracts/schemas/ with example payloads under schemas/examples/. The schema layer must separate ingress requests, environmental release scenarios, run options, concentration outputs, comparison records, export bundles, and assumption records. Every outward-facing object must carry schemaVersion, provenance, limitations, fitForPurpose, qualityFlags, modelFamily tags, and explicit geographic/time semantics. Publish contracts://manifest and example manifests so downstream services can introspect the module cleanly.
tasks.testStrategy: Run schema validation across all examples, ensure media and unit enumerations are enforced, and confirm the manifest references only valid schemas and examples.

subtasks.title: Define common provenance, semantic, and geography/time primitives
subtasks.description: Create reusable schema fragments for all fate-facing records.
subtasks.details: Implement shared fragments for provenance bundles, assumption source references, uncertainty/limitation notes, compartment enums, media enums, region/context identifiers, time-window semantics, model-family identifiers, and fit-for-purpose markers. Store them in docs/contracts/schemas/ or a generated common layer and document allowed values and extension rules.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate the fragments independently and ensure they can be composed by all planned schemas without ambiguity.

subtasks.title: Create ingress schemas for release scenarios and run options
subtasks.description: Define how release assumptions enter the module.
subtasks.details: Publish environmentalReleaseScenario.v1, fateModelRunOptions.v1, and companion request schemas for building release scenarios and estimating multimedia concentrations. Capture source term or emission rate, release fractions, duration/timing, site or region context, optional treatment/removal assumptions, and declared evidence provenance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write schema tests covering valid release cases, missing required fields, and invalid media or timing combinations.

subtasks.title: Create concentration-surface and run-summary output schemas
subtasks.description: Define the core outward-facing fate objects used downstream.
subtasks.details: Publish concentrationSurface.v1, concentrationSurfaceBundle.v1, fateRunSummary.v1, and fateAssumptionRecord.v1. Require fields for medium, compartment, geographic scope, steady-state or time-window semantics, concentration value and unit, scenario/model family, limitations, provenance, and fit-for-purpose tags.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate examples for steady-state air and water outputs, a time-bucket surface bundle, and a fully specified assumption ledger.

subtasks.title: Create comparison and export contract schemas
subtasks.description: Define the harmonized records used for scenario comparison and downstream consumption.
subtasks.details: Publish fateScenarioComparisonRecord.v1, exportConcentrationSurfaceBundleRequest.v1, and exposureConsumptionPackage.v1. Ensure comparison records can express both numeric deltas and assumption-driver changes and that export contracts remain agnostic to any single fate engine brand.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that comparison examples capture both concentration deltas and assumption deltas and that export payloads validate directly against downstream consumer expectations.

subtasks.title: Generate contract manifests and example catalogs
subtasks.description: Make the schema layer machine-readable for MCP clients and downstream services.
subtasks.details: Implement generation logic in src/fate_mcp/contracts.py and examples.py to publish contracts://manifest, schema manifests, example manifests, and dependency descriptors. Keep docs/contracts/schemas/ and schemas/examples/ synchronized from the same source definitions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run the generation command twice and verify the outputs are deterministic, stable, and free of stale references.

tasks.title: Implement defaults, provenance, and region-profile registries
tasks.description: Create the governed data layers that supply versioned defaults, contextual profiles, and assumption tracking for all fate runs.
tasks.details: Implement versioned defaults and registry loaders in src/fate_mcp/defaults.py and src/fate_mcp/provenance.py. Store curated defaults under defaults/v1/ with a published defaults/manifest.json containing file hashes, effective dates, evidence sources, and curation notes. Add region/context profile support, source hierarchy rules (user_input vs curated_default vs derived), and quality-flag emission for surrogate values or heuristics.
tasks.testStrategy: Load the registry in tests, verify hashes and metadata are stable, and confirm every applied default appears in output assumption records with the correct source classification.

subtasks.title: Build the versioned defaults registry and manifest pipeline
subtasks.description: Load curated fate defaults from immutable files and publish their metadata.
subtasks.details: Implement DefaultsRegistry with support for defaults/manifest.json and defaults/v1/*.json. Capture parameter names, values, units, source IDs, effective dates, applicability notes, and SHA256 hashes so release reports can detect drift and stale files.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit-test registry loading, manifest hashing, version lookup, and failure behavior for malformed or mismatched defaults files.

subtasks.title: Implement governed region and context profile packs
subtasks.description: Support region-aware assumptions without forking the public contract model.
subtasks.details: Create fateRegionProfile.v1 and supporting loaders for region, climate, compartment, and optional contextual packs. Store curated packs alongside defaults and expose a manifest describing coverage, applicability, and known gaps.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test profile selection across at least two distinct regional contexts and verify unsupported combinations fail with clear diagnostics.

subtasks.title: Implement the assumption and provenance kernel
subtasks.description: Track every user, defaulted, and derived value used during fate computation.
subtasks.details: Create provenance builders that attach source hierarchy, citations, effective dates, derivation notes, and assumption records to each result. Reuse shared provenance patterns from the suite where possible while keeping fate-specific semantics explicit.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write tests that compare outputs with and without user overrides and confirm the assumption ledger changes predictably and completely.

subtasks.title: Emit limitation notes and quality flags for heuristic inputs
subtasks.description: Surface degraded evidence quality whenever the runtime falls back to surrogates or heuristics.
subtasks.details: Implement rule tables that mark surrogate physicochemical values, inferred release fractions, or approximate treatment assumptions with warning-quality flags and limitation notes. Ensure these flags appear in concentration surfaces, comparison records, and export bundles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Exercise heuristic pathways in tests and verify warning-quality flags and limitation notes are emitted exactly where expected.

subtasks.title: Publish defaults evidence maps and curation guidance
subtasks.description: Make the curated parameter sources inspectable for reviewers and maintainers.
subtasks.details: Add docs/defaults_evidence_map.md and curation guidance explaining evidence tiers, review status, and update procedure for defaults and regional profiles. Link this guidance from operator and release resources.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review the evidence map against the manifest and confirm every curated file has a documented provenance path and update rule.

tasks.title: Build the model-agnostic runtime kernel and plugin SPI
tasks.description: Create the execution core that validates inputs, dispatches by workflow class, computes concentrations, and returns future-safe result metadata.
tasks.details: Implement the runtime in src/fate_mcp/runtime.py with explicit plugin interfaces under src/fate_mcp/plugins/. The runtime should validate release scenarios and run options, dispatch by scenario/model family, attach result metadata, and keep public abstractions centered on building release scenarios and estimating concentration surfaces rather than exposing model-branded APIs. Add result_meta.py and errors.py semantics that can support synchronous v0.1 responses while reserving future async states cleanly.
tasks.testStrategy: Run unit and integration tests covering plugin registration, dispatch, validation failures, and deterministic output metadata for successful and unsuccessful runs.

subtasks.title: Define runtime interfaces and result metadata semantics
subtasks.description: Specify the request/response flow used by all fate tools.
subtasks.details: Create runtime abstractions for validated inputs, execution context, result metadata, plugin contracts, and standardized error payloads. Mirror the suite's terminal sync execution semantics while reserving fields for future asynchronous modes without changing v0.1 public contracts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test serialization of completed and failed result metadata and confirm runtime objects can round-trip through the public schema layer.

subtasks.title: Implement the plugin registry keyed by workflow and model family
subtasks.description: Allow multiple fate engines to plug into the same harmonized surface.
subtasks.details: Create a registry that maps scenario classes and model families to concrete plugins. Enforce that all plugins return normalized concentration_surface objects and declare their applicability, limitations, and required parameters.
subtasks.testStrategy: Register multiple fake plugins in tests and verify dispatch, duplicate-registration protection, and unsupported-family errors.

subtasks.title: Add the reference steady-state mass-balance kernel
subtasks.description: Provide a native deterministic baseline for concentration estimation.
subtasks.details: Implement a plugin that computes compartment concentrations from bounded release assumptions using a transparent mass-balance approach. Keep calculations explicit, inspectable, and aligned to the compartment/time semantics defined by the contracts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Benchmark the kernel against hand-worked fixtures and verify the returned concentration surfaces carry complete provenance and limitation data.

subtasks.title: Add bounded time-bucket concentration support
subtasks.description: Extend the runtime beyond a single steady-state snapshot without requiring full dynamic simulation.
subtasks.details: Implement a bounded workflow that can emit concentration surfaces over declared time buckets while reusing the same concentration_surface contract. Preserve explicit start/end semantics and prevent the output from masquerading as a full mechanistic time-series solver.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test multi-bucket scenarios, boundary conditions, and failure cases for inconsistent timing inputs or unsupported dynamic requests.

subtasks.title: Implement negative-path validation and failure transparency
subtasks.description: Ensure invalid or incompatible requests fail clearly and predictably.
subtasks.details: Add validation guards for impossible medium/unit combinations, missing required parameters, incompatible region profiles, and unsupported plugin selections. Standardize error codes and limitation messaging for downstream orchestrators.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write negative tests that assert specific failure modes, messages, and machine-readable error metadata for each major invalid-input class.

tasks.title: Implement core release-scenario and concentration-estimation workflows
tasks.description: Turn the PRD tool surface into working release ingress, concentration estimation, and evidence-handling operations built on the runtime kernel.
tasks.details: Implement the core scenario and evidence workflows in src/fate_mcp/server.py, integrations.py, and supporting modules. The public operations should build validated release scenarios, estimate multimedia concentrations, assemble concentration bundles, and reconcile physicochemical or release evidence without leaking engine-specific internals into the contract surface.
tasks.testStrategy: Exercise the core tools end-to-end with representative examples and verify they produce valid contracts, complete assumption records, and deterministic outputs under repeated execution.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_build_environmental_release_scenario
subtasks.description: Provide a tool path that validates and normalizes release assumptions into the public contract.
subtasks.details: Create the build step that accepts release inputs, resolves defaults, attaches region/context profiles, and emits a validated environmental_release_scenario object with provenance and limitation notes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run request-validation and golden-example tests ensuring equivalent inputs normalize identically and invalid release inputs fail cleanly.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_estimate_multimedia_concentrations
subtasks.description: Provide the main concentration-estimation workflow for the module.
subtasks.details: Wire the runtime kernel into a tool that accepts a release scenario and run options, selects the correct plugin, and returns concentration_surface or concentration_surface_bundle outputs plus run summaries and result metadata.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test successful execution across supported workflow classes and verify model-family tags, units, and provenance fields are populated correctly.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_build_concentration_surface_bundle
subtasks.description: Create a reusable packaged output for downstream consumers.
subtasks.details: Add bundle assembly logic that groups concentration surfaces, summaries, assumptions, and dependency descriptors into a stable concentration_surface_bundle for future concentration-to-dose services.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate the bundle against its schema and confirm downstream stub consumers can parse it without bespoke transformations.

subtasks.title: Implement physicochemical evidence ingestion and fit assessment
subtasks.description: Allow supporting evidence to update or qualify scenario inputs without bypassing provenance controls.
subtasks.details: Implement fate_apply_physchem_evidence and fate_assess_release_scenario_fit so supporting data can enrich parameter records, update defaults, or report mismatches. Preserve review status, evidence quality, and change provenance in every output.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test enrichment with higher-quality evidence, rejection of incompatible evidence, and fit reports that clearly explain any mismatches or downgraded confidence.

subtasks.title: Implement release-evidence reconciliation workflows
subtasks.description: Provide a harmonized way to compare and reconcile multiple release assumptions.
subtasks.details: Implement fate_reconcile_release_evidence to merge competing release descriptions into a reviewable reconciliation report that highlights agreed values, unresolved conflicts, and recommended next actions. Ensure the reconciled scenario remains distinct from raw evidence records.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create tests covering consistent evidence merges, conflicting release-rate inputs, and preservation of source-level provenance across the reconciliation result.

tasks.title: Implement comparison outputs and downstream concentration-consumption packages
tasks.description: Enable scenario comparison, stable export bundles, and downstream interoperability without leaking fate-engine internals.
tasks.details: Implement the comparison and export layer in src/fate_mcp/integrations.py and supporting modules. Provide comparison records that expose both numeric concentration differences and assumption drivers, and build export packages that downstream concentration-to-dose or intake services can consume through shared contracts rather than custom mappings.
tasks.testStrategy: Run downstream-consumer stub tests ensuring comparison outputs, concentration bundles, and exposure-consumption packages validate and remain stable across repeated generation.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_compare_fate_scenarios
subtasks.description: Provide transparent comparison between alternative release and fate assumptions.
subtasks.details: Create comparison logic that aligns concentration surfaces by medium, compartment, and time semantics, then emits deltas, dominant drivers, and changed assumptions in a fate_scenario_comparison_record.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test comparisons across changed release rates, changed defaults, and changed region profiles, verifying both numeric and assumption-level differences are explicit.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_export_concentration_surface_bundle
subtasks.description: Export normalized concentration bundles for external consumers.
subtasks.details: Create an export path that packages selected concentration surfaces, metadata, assumptions, and dependency descriptors into a transportable concentration_surface_bundle with stable schema and version metadata.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate exported bundles against schema and parse them in a downstream stub consumer to ensure no model-native leakage occurs.

subtasks.title: Implement fate_export_exposure_consumption_package
subtasks.description: Prepare a shared handoff object for downstream exposure or intake workflows.
subtasks.details: Build a normalized package containing concentration surfaces, selected contexts, time semantics, and provenance sufficient for downstream concentration-to-dose or media-intake services. Keep the payload focused on consumable semantics rather than the details of any one fate engine.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that downstream stubs for Direct-Use Exposure MCP or future intake services can ingest the package without custom field-by-field mapping.

subtasks.title: Add contract-level interoperability checks for downstream consumers
subtasks.description: Protect the cross-MCP handoff boundary through automated validation.
subtasks.details: Create integration tests that validate bundle and export outputs against shared contract expectations, including dependency descriptors, provenance bundles, and limitation notes required by downstream services.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run end-to-end contract checks with synthetic consumer fixtures and fail if any required field, unit, or provenance element is missing or ambiguous.

tasks.title: Publish the MCP server surface, resources, examples, and operator guidance
tasks.description: Expose the tool catalog and machine-readable resources in a way that stays synchronized with schemas, defaults, and release artifacts.
tasks.details: Compose the server layer in src/fate_mcp/server.py using modular registrars rather than a single sprawling file. Expose the planned tools, machine-readable resources for contracts, defaults, archetypes, validation, and release posture, plus synchronized examples and operator-facing documentation. Keep tools, resources, schemas, examples, and docs regenerated from the same governed sources whenever possible.
tasks.testStrategy: Run server smoke tests that enumerate tools and resources, then verify every published schema, example, manifest, and doc resource resolves without stale references.

subtasks.title: Compose the modular server registrar and tool catalog
subtasks.description: Expose the public tool surface cleanly and keep the server composition maintainable.
subtasks.details: Split server registration by domain slice such as scenario construction, evidence utilities, exports, and resources. Register fate_build_environmental_release_scenario, fate_estimate_multimedia_concentrations, fate_build_concentration_surface_bundle, fate_compare_fate_scenarios, fate_apply_physchem_evidence, fate_assess_release_scenario_fit, fate_reconcile_release_evidence, fate_export_concentration_surface_bundle, and fate_export_exposure_consumption_package.
subtasks.testStrategy: Enumerate the MCP surface in tests and verify every registered tool resolves to a callable implementation with the expected input/output schemas.

subtasks.title: Publish machine-readable resource catalogs
subtasks.description: Expose manifests, defaults, archetypes, and release posture as MCP resources.
subtasks.details: Register resources such as contracts://manifest, schemas://{schema_name}, examples://{example_name}, defaults://manifest, fate-archetypes://manifest, docs://operator-guide, docs://provenance-policy, docs://validation-framework, docs://fate-model-boundary-guide, docs://suite-integration-guide, release://metadata-report, release://readiness-report, and release://security-provenance-review-report.
subtasks.testStrategy: Smoke-test each resource URI and confirm the returned payload matches the declared schema or document contract.

subtasks.title: Publish operator guidance, provenance policy, and suite-integration docs
subtasks.description: Document how to use the module without overselling unsupported semantics.
subtasks.details: Write docs/operator_guide.md, docs/provenance_policy.md, docs/validation_framework.md, docs/fate_model_boundary_guide.md, and docs/suite_integration.md. Explain supported compartments, time semantics, quality flags, boundary rules, and how downstream consumers should interpret concentration bundles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review docs against the actual tool and contract surfaces and confirm that all deferred features are labeled honestly.

subtasks.title: Generate synchronized examples and manifests
subtasks.description: Keep examples and machine-readable catalogs aligned with the current contracts and tools.
subtasks.details: Create representative examples for release scenario construction, steady-state estimation, bounded time-bucket outputs, comparison records, and downstream export bundles. Generate example manifests and dependency descriptors from the same source-of-truth code paths used by the server resources.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate every example against its schema and compare regenerated manifests to ensure the process is deterministic.

subtasks.title: Update README, developer commands, and release notes stubs
subtasks.description: Make the new module operable for maintainers and early adopters.
subtasks.details: Add README installation and usage guidance, developer commands for lint/test/build/contract-generation, and placeholder release notes under docs/releases/. Ensure the boundary and release posture are summarized prominently.
subtasks.testStrategy: Follow the documented commands in a clean checkout and confirm they match the actual repository workflow without missing steps.

tasks.title: Build the validation, benchmark, and regression suite
tasks.description: Prove the fate math, schema surface, defaults governance, and export stability are good enough for release.
tasks.details: Implement validation and benchmark infrastructure in src/fate_mcp/benchmarks.py, validation.py, and tests/. Cover hand-worked mass-balance fixtures, representative reference cases, schema/example validation, negative-path tests, default-drift detection, comparison transparency, and reproducibility of generated artifacts. Publish benchmark manifests, validation dossiers, applicability notes, and known-gap reports as release resources.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the full suite in CI and a clean local environment, verifying that benchmark tolerances, schema integrity, and release-artifact reproducibility are all enforced.

subtasks.title: Create hand-worked mass-balance benchmark fixtures
subtasks.description: Establish transparent baseline cases for the native kernels.
subtasks.details: Author benchmark inputs and expected outputs for simple air, water, soil, and multi-compartment mass-balance cases with manually checked concentrations and assumptions. Store fixture metadata and tolerances in a machine-readable manifest.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run the native kernels against the fixtures and confirm the outputs match the hand-worked expectations within declared tolerances.

subtasks.title: Create representative reference cases for supported model families
subtasks.description: Anchor validation to recognizable external or literature-style cases where possible.
subtasks.details: Curate a small suite of reference cases aligned to supported model families or published examples, documenting any simplifications and mapping assumptions required to normalize them into the public contracts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the normalized outputs stay within the expected ranges and that model-family tags and limitations are preserved in each case.

subtasks.title: Add schema, example, and negative-path validation coverage
subtasks.description: Ensure the public surface fails fast when contracts or inputs drift.
subtasks.details: Write automated tests for every published schema and example, including invalid media/unit combinations, unsupported time semantics, malformed defaults, and illegal export bundles. Add coverage for failure transparency and result metadata.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run the validation suite and confirm both positive and negative cases produce the expected machine-readable outcomes.

subtasks.title: Add defaults-drift and comparison-transparency regression tests
subtasks.description: Protect the auditable-first posture against silent changes.
subtasks.details: Create regression tests that fail when defaults versions or hashes change unexpectedly, when assumption ledgers omit applied values, or when comparison outputs stop surfacing dominant driver deltas explicitly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Intentionally modify a fixture or default in test mode and confirm the regression checks detect the drift and report the correct failure context.

subtasks.title: Add artifact integrity and reproducibility checks
subtasks.description: Verify generated release outputs are stable and tamper-evident.
subtasks.details: Test release metadata generation, contract manifests, defaults manifests, and built package artifacts for deterministic reproduction and hash verification. Make artifact integrity checks part of CI and release gating.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run the artifact checks twice in clean environments and verify byte-for-byte or hash-stable outputs where expected, with clear failures on mismatches.

tasks.title: Prepare model-family adapter boundaries and extension hooks
tasks.description: Define how future external model families and richer region packs plug into Fate MCP without destabilizing the core contracts.
tasks.details: Design an adapter SPI in src/fate_mcp/integrations.py or plugins/ that can normalize external fate model outputs into concentration_surface records. Keep this work additive and non-blocking for the initial native release: the goal is to prepare stable extension hooks, not to expose raw model-native APIs as the public surface.
tasks.testStrategy: Review the adapter boundary against the contracts and run smoke tests or harness tests proving that normalized outputs remain schema-valid and provenance-complete.

subtasks.title: Publish the adapter SPI for external model families
subtasks.description: Define the interface external fate engines must implement to participate in the harmonized runtime.
subtasks.details: Document required methods, input normalization rules, output obligations, and provenance requirements for SimpleBox-, EUSES-, or ChemFate-style adapters. Include explicit rules for declaring applicability and limitations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review the SPI with maintainers and confirm it is sufficient to normalize at least two distinct model-family shapes without changing public contracts.

subtasks.title: Implement a reference adapter harness or stub plugin
subtasks.description: Provide a concrete example of the adapter boundary in action.
subtasks.details: Create a lightweight reference adapter or stub that maps external-model-like outputs into concentration_surface records, assumption records, and run summaries. Keep the harness synthetic if no supported engine is bundled yet.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run smoke tests that feed the harness representative outputs and verify the normalized results validate against public schemas.

subtasks.title: Document model applicability limits and deferred capabilities
subtasks.description: Prevent adapter work from overselling unsupported semantics.
subtasks.details: Add guidance describing which model families are native, adapter-only, or deferred; which inputs are harmonized; and which features such as GIS dispersion or full probabilistic workflows remain out of scope.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review docs against the SPI and verify no unsupported model capability is implied by the public resource catalog.

subtasks.title: Prepare richer region-pack extension hooks
subtasks.description: Allow regional context packs to expand later without forking the contract model.
subtasks.details: Define manifest and loading conventions for additional region profiles, compartment packs, and optional transfer factors that can be added after v0.1 while preserving the existing region-profile contract.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add tests that load a synthetic extension pack and confirm backward compatibility with existing region-profile selection behavior.

tasks.title: Harden release artifacts and ship Fate MCP v0.1
tasks.description: Package the first production-grade version of the module once contracts, runtime, docs, and validation all pass release gates.
tasks.details: Prepare release notes, migration notes, benchmark summaries, validation dossiers, and machine-readable release metadata. Tag v0.1.0 only after schema/example validation, benchmark replication, defaults-manifest publication, downstream bundle-consumption checks, and artifact-integrity verification all pass in a clean environment.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the tagged release reproduces the same benchmark, contract, and export results in a clean environment before publication.

subtasks.title: Generate machine-readable release reports
subtasks.description: Produce the metadata and governance artifacts required for auditable distribution.
subtasks.details: Implement release metadata, readiness, and security-provenance review reports that summarize schema counts, example counts, defaults versions, artifact hashes, supported workflows, known limitations, and validation posture.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate the release reports against their schemas and confirm their values match the build outputs and current manifests.

subtasks.title: Freeze benchmark manifests and known-gap reports
subtasks.description: Make the validation posture explicit at release time.
subtasks.details: Publish benchmark manifests, applicability notes, and known-gap reports describing unsupported compartments, deferred dynamic behaviors, and any adapter limitations. Link these documents from release resources and docs/releases/.
subtasks.testStrategy: Cross-check the known-gap report against the validation suite and confirm every intentional limitation is documented exactly once.

subtasks.title: Perform end-to-end downstream dry runs
subtasks.description: Verify the released outputs are consumable by neighboring services.
subtasks.details: Run clean end-to-end scenarios that produce concentration_surface_bundle and exposure_consumption_package outputs, then validate them with downstream consumer stubs or integration checks for Direct-Use Exposure MCP and future intake workflows.
subtasks.testStrategy: Capture successful dry-run artifacts and fail the release if any handoff requires ad hoc field mapping or manual cleanup.

subtasks.title: Prepare release notes and versioned artifacts
subtasks.description: Finalize packaging and public-facing release documentation.
subtasks.details: Build wheel and sdist artifacts, compute hashes and sizes, update README and docs/releases/, and summarize highlights, non-goals, known limitations, and migration notes for v0.1.0.
subtasks.testStrategy: Install the built artifacts in a clean environment and verify the documented commands, resource catalogs, and contract-generation paths all work as described.

subtasks.title: Tag and publish Fate MCP v0.1.0
subtasks.description: Ship the first stable release once all release gates pass.
subtasks.details: Create the v0.1.0 tag only after CI, validation, artifact integrity, and downstream dry runs are green. Record the final defaults version, schema manifest version, and known limitations in the release metadata.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the tagged release reproduces the same hashes, metadata, benchmark outputs, and contract manifests as the pre-release candidate.

metadata.description: TaskMaster plan generated from the Fate MCP PRD with source-to-concentration scope, subtasks, and dependencies.
